newsitem.title: USA: Anheuser-Busch market share up 1.1 points.
newsitem.headline: Anheuser-Busch market share up 1.1 points.

text.p: Anheuser-Busch Cos Inc said Wednesday its beer market share increased 1.1 points to 45.2 percent in 1996 thanks to record sales.

The company reported it sold 91.1 million barrels of beer in 1996, up 4.1 percent from 1995 levels. Excluding the impact of a 1995 inventory reduction, 1996 beer volume increased 2.8 percent compared to one year ago, Anheuser-Busch said.
The brewer added net revenue per barrel for 1996 climbed nearly three percent versus 1995.
Anheuser-Busch is the nation's largest brewing company.
Its shares were trading up 7/8 Wednesday afternoon at 43.
